provenance_note: Engineering fact table compiled from public handbooks, standards and manufacturer datasheets. Record-level property_basis distinguishes typical/nominal data, published minima, characteristic values and analyst assumptions. Engineering selections are not received-stock certificates or design allowables; incomplete constitutive data must not be replaced with invented isotropic properties. No MatWeb/MakeItFrom/Matmatch content.

steel_42crmo4_qt_round_le40.name: 42CrMo4 +QT round <=40 mm (750 MPa minimum)
steel_42crmo4_qt_round_le40.condition: +QT, EN ISO 683-2 / 1.7225, round-bar ruling section at heat treatment <=40 mm

property_basis.yield_mpa: minimum: >16 to 40 mm round bar; conservative combined <=40 mm envelope subject to supplier confirmation at band boundaries
property_basis.ultimate_mpa: minimum of 1000-1200 MPa tensile range for >16 to 40 mm round bar
property_basis.section_note: The <16 mm band has 900 MPa minimum yield. Ruling section is stock/effective section during heat treatment, not a subsequently machined neck. Not a flat-stock diameter rule.

steel_42crmo4_qt_round_le40.selection_status: Engineering selection; require section-qualified mechanical acceptance and EN 10204 3.1 certificate. No received-stock certification.
steel_42crmo4_qt_round_le40.finish_note: Illustrative machined steel. Protect exposed non-fit surfaces; mask bearing/key/seal fits. No coating or surface-hardening certification.

provenance.source: Saarstahl 42CrMo4/42CrMoS4 +QT table p1 (DIN EN 10083); Ovako 42CrMo4 mechanical/other properties and EN ISO 683-2 designation

steel_42crmo4_qt_round_gt40_le100.name: 42CrMo4 +QT round >40-100 mm (650 MPa minimum)
steel_42crmo4_qt_round_gt40_le100.condition: +QT, EN ISO 683-2 / 1.7225, round-bar ruling section at heat treatment >40 to 100 mm

property_basis.yield_mpa: minimum for >40 to 100 mm round ruling section
property_basis.section_note: Not applicable to arbitrary 100 mm plate: the separate flat-stock 650 MPa band is 20-60 mm thickness; 60-100 mm flat stock is 550 MPa. A machined neck does not reset the heat-treatment section.

steel_42crmo4_qt_round_gt40_le100.selection_status: Engineering selection; require section-qualified mechanical acceptance and EN 10204 3.1 certificate. A generic 4140 chemistry or hardness callout is not equivalent.
steel_42crmo4_qt_round_gt40_le100.finish_note: Illustrative machined steel; protect exposed non-fit surfaces and mask functional fits.

provenance.source: Saarstahl 42CrMo4/42CrMoS4 +QT table p1, separate round diameter/flat thickness rows; Ovako typical elastic/physical properties

steel_42crmo4_qt_flat_gt60_lt100.name: 42CrMo4 +QT flat 60<t<100 mm (550 MPa minimum)
steel_42crmo4_qt_flat_gt60_lt100.condition: +QT, 1.7225, flat-stock ruling thickness at heat treatment strictly between 60 and 100 mm

property_basis.yield_mpa: Saarstahl minimum for flat stock 60<t<100 mm at heat treatment
property_basis.section_note: Select a nominal 70 mm flat blank when machining a 60 mm deep hub, retaining machining allowance without claiming the thinner-stock 650 MPa minimum. Round-bar diameter is a separate qualification.

steel_42crmo4_qt_flat_gt60_lt100.selection_status: Engineering selection; require actual product/heat-treatment section and EN 10204 3.1 certification. Not a received-stock certificate.
steel_42crmo4_qt_flat_gt60_lt100.finish_note: Illustrative machined steel; protect exposed non-fit surfaces and mask functional fits.

provenance.source: Saarstahl 42CrMo4/42CrMoS4 +QT table p1, flat thickness row; Ovako typical elastic/physical properties

aluminum_6061_t6_plate_unwelded_min240.name: EN AW-6061 T6/T651 unwelded plate (240 MPa minimum)
aluminum_6061_t6_plate_unwelded_min240.condition: EN 485-2 sheet/plate, T6/T651, unwelded parent metal, thickness <=150 mm for the stated yield minimum

property_basis.E_mpa: Eurocode aluminum elastic design convention, also typical supplier value
property_basis.nu: EN 1999-1-1:2007 section 3.2.5 design convention, not separately measured
property_basis.yield_mpa: EN 485-2 Rp0.2 minimum, supplier sheet/plate table through 150 mm
property_basis.tensile_minimum_note: Relevant thin plate has Rm minimum 290 MPa, but thicker-plate minima differ; no single ultimate_mpa is assigned across the full thickness range.
property_basis.section_note: Do not apply to welded HAZ or extrusions. Confirm the selected product/thickness against the supplier table. Typical 276 MPa is not a guaranteed plate yield.

aluminum_6061_t6_plate_unwelded_min240.selection_status: Engineering selection, not a mill certificate or weld qualification.
aluminum_6061_t6_plate_unwelded_min240.finish_note: Illustrative aluminum; clear sealed anodize recommended on exposed surfaces with fit allowance and separately qualified bonding preparation. No strength credit.

provenance.source: thyssenkrupp 6061 datasheet pp2-3,5; EN 1999-1-1:2007 section 3.2.5

finnish_birch_plywood_9mm_7ply.name: Finnish birch plywood 9 mm 7-ply
aliases: Finnish birch plywood 9 mm seven ply
finnish_birch_plywood_9mm_7ply.condition: Birch throughout, standard cross-banded seven-ply panel, nominal 9 mm; handbook density at 65% relative humidity

property_basis.density_g_cm3: mean design density, Table 3-1; not a guaranteed mass or lower bound
property_basis.density_condition: Handbook mechanical specimens conditioned at 20 C and 65% RH; characteristic density is distinct from mean density.

constitutive_gaps: Selected panel homogenized E3 and three independent Poisson ratios
Moisture/time reductions and through-thickness, rolling/interlaminar, bolt-bearing and edge-failure data
Complete qualified orthotropic constitutive/failure model; no isotropic E/nu/yield substitute
finnish_birch_plywood_9mm_7ply.selection_status: Engineering panel selection, not evidence of the original Comet stock or received product certification.
finnish_birch_plywood_9mm_7ply.finish_note: Illustrative natural birch tint, not measured color or wood-grain texture. Seal faces, cut edges and holes; qualify adhesive-bond surfaces separately. Actual sealant/product unqualified.

provenance.source: Finnish Forest Industries Federation, Handbook of Finnish Plywood (2002), sections 2.1/3.1, Tables 2-3 and 3-1; primary-organization handbook hosted by supplier

tpu_ultimaker_s95a_black.name: UltiMaker S-series TPU 95A black
tpu_ultimaker_s95a_black.condition: Printed on S5, 100% infill, 0.15 mm layers, AA0.4, Cura 4.9; 2.85 mm filament

property_basis.density_g_cm3: manufacturer nominal material density; not effective density of a partially filled print
property_basis.value_class: Typical printed-specimen values, not guaranteed minima; no yield point. Break stress is not yield.

constitutive_gaps: Full directional stress-strain, hyperelastic/viscoelastic calibration, cyclic/fatigue and print/bond qualification
tpu_ultimaker_s95a_black.selection_status: Engineering filament/process selection, not certified tread capacity.
tpu_ultimaker_s95a_black.finish_note: Illustrative black uncoated tread. Black color does not qualify UV resistance; manufacturer excludes long-term UV/moisture immersion.

provenance.source: UltiMaker printed TPU 95A TDS pp2-3; filename v5.00, internal footer v2.00 dated 29 Apr 2022

hdpe_king_starboard_black.name: King StarBoard marine HDPE black
hdpe_king_starboard_black.condition: Marine-grade HDPE sheet, factory matte, black, unpainted

property_basis.value_class: All values explicitly nominal, not procurement minima or sustained-load allowables; flexural modulus is the nominal bending datum.

constitutive_gaps: Temperature/time-dependent creep, relaxation, fatigue and permanent-load allowables
hdpe_king_starboard_black.selection_status: Engineering product selection, not evidence of supplied seat stock or certification.
hdpe_king_starboard_black.finish_note: Illustrative black factory-matte surface; retain factory finish and clean edges, no painting required.

provenance.source: King StarBoard Physical Properties p1 nominal values/disclaimer; manufacturer product/color/HDPE identification

pom_c_ensinger_tecaform_ah_natural.name: Ensinger TECAFORM AH natural POM-C
pom_c_ensinger_tecaform_ah_natural.condition: Unfilled POM-C stock, machined natural surface, protected from prolonged weather

property_basis.value_class: Guideline short-term test values; manufacturer prohibits treating them as specifications. Compressive 20 MPa at 1% strain is not a creep-safe allowable.

constitutive_gaps: Temperature/time-dependent creep, clamp relaxation, compression curves, fatigue and certified lower bounds
pom_c_ensinger_tecaform_ah_natural.selection_status: Engineering stock selection, not received-stock certification.
pom_c_ensinger_tecaform_ah_natural.finish_note: Illustrative natural machined acetal. Poor weathering and difficult bonding; shield from prolonged sunlight, do not assume adhesive retention or indefinite clamp load.

provenance.source: Ensinger TECAFORM AH natural TDS p1, version AF 19 Jul 2023, properties and disclaimer

steel_iso898_1_class10_9.name: ISO 898-1 class 10.9 full-loadability fastener steel
steel_iso898_1_class10_9.condition: ISO 898-1:2013 class 10.9, full-loadability bolts/screws; reduced-head products excluded

property_basis.E_mpa: analyst steel elastic-screening assumption, not ISO 898-1 requirement
property_basis.nu: analyst steel elastic-screening assumption, not ISO 898-1 requirement
property_basis.density_g_cm3: analyst steel mass assumption, not ISO 898-1 requirement
property_basis.yield_mpa: minimum Rp0.2, not designation nominal yield 900

steel_iso898_1_class10_9.selection_status: Engineering full-loadability fastener selection; require traceable manufacturer. No certificate, preload, torque-clamp, fatigue or shear capacity implied.
steel_iso898_1_class10_9.finish_note: Illustrative metallic fastener. Manufacturer ISO 10683 zinc-flake with defined friction/topcoat recommended, subject to small-thread/internal-drive suitability; no coating or preload certification.

provenance.source: ISO 898-1:2013 Table 3 p8, scope exclusions pp1-2, designation section 5; elastic constants separately labeled analyst assumptions

bronze_c93200_b505_m07.name: C93200 SAE 660 continuous-cast ASTM B505 M07
bronze_c93200_b505_m07.condition: Continuous-cast C93200/SAE660, ASTM B505/B505M temper M07

property_basis.yield_note: 0.5% extension-under-load convention is NOT 0.2% offset or a proven elastic/J2 limit. Sand/centrifugal cast forms have different lower minima and are not this stock selection.

constitutive_gaps: Lubrication-dependent PV, friction and wear limits
bronze_c93200_b505_m07.selection_status: Engineering continuous-cast stock selection, not certification or a dry-running bearing rating.
bronze_c93200_b505_m07.finish_note: Illustrative bronze. Running bore unpainted and finished for separately selected lubrication regime.

provenance.source: Copper Development Association C93200 mechanical/physical/specification tables; Morgan Bronze ASTM B505 supply

property_basis.yield_mpa: supplier-listed minimum for the named variant/condition, subject to product/application disclaimer and contractual confirmation
property_basis.section_note: Supplier notes hardenability approximately a ring with 17 mm wall; this does not qualify arbitrary sections.

steel_100cr6_ovako803j_qtm.selection_status: Engineering condition-specific selection only. Require supplier confirmation; actual bearing capacity/life uses bearing catalog ratings, not bulk steel yield.
steel_100cr6_ovako803j_qtm.finish_note: Illustrative finished bearing steel; retain manufacturer race finish, seals and grease, do not coat raceways.
